defs.def: a person who is between 13 and 19 years old （13 至 19 岁之间的）青少年，少年，少女

ex.s: Volunteering has a lifelong effect on kids and teenagers.
ex.t: 志愿服务对孩子和青少年有一生的影响。

ex.s: Not too long ago, on a cold winter night, there was a teenager who wanted more screen time and a parent who said no.
ex.t: 不久前，在一个寒冷的冬夜，有一个想要更多屏幕时间的少年，和一位说“不行”的家长。

ex.s: “I thought, in this family, we don’t compare ourselves with other people, Dad?” the teenager replied.
ex.t: "我以为，在这个家里，我们不和别人攀比呢，爸爸？"那个少年回答道。

ex.s: It is believed that today's children and teenagers are consuming three times the recommended level of sugar, putting them at a higher risk of the disease.
ex.t: 据信，如今的儿童和青少年摄入的糖是建议量的三倍，使他们患该病的风险更高。

ex.s: After long discussions we somehow agreed to do a study on the psychological well-being of teenagers.
ex.t: 经过长时间讨论，我们不知怎的同意做一项关于青少年心理健康的研究。

ex.s: Then a rail—thin teenager, in a baggy white T—shirt, skidded（滑）up to the beam.
ex.t: 然后一个骨瘦如柴的少年，穿着宽松的白T恤，滑着靠近横梁。

ex.s: “I’m going to miss you so much, Poppy,” said the tall, thin teenager.
ex.t: "我会非常想念你的，波比，"那个瘦高的少年说。

ex.s: "That was my home． I was a teenager sitting in the hall． Before you came over， I never realized what a beautiful place I lived in． I never felt lucky before． You thought it was a museum． My feelings about my home changed after that． I've always wanted to thank you．"
ex.t: “那是我家。我当时是个坐在厅里的少年。你来之前，我从没意识到自己住的地方多美。我以前从没觉得自己幸运。你以为那是博物馆。从那以后我对家的感觉变了。我一直想谢谢你。”

ex.s: People tend to educate teenagers at a museum．
ex.t: D．人倾向于在博物馆教育青少年。

ex.s: Many teenagers love using their artistic talents to collage.
ex.t: 许多青少年喜欢用他们的艺术才能做拼贴。

ex.s: Changing levels of body chemicals called hormones not only make teenagers’ bodies develop adult characteristics, but also make it hard for teenagers to fall asleep before 11 pm.
ex.t: 被称为激素的身体化学物质水平的变化，不仅让青少年身体发育出成人特征，还让他们在晚上11点前难以入睡。

ex.s: Because sleepiness is such a problem for teenagers, some school districts have decided to start high school classes later than they used to.
ex.t: 身体内称为激素的化学物质水平的变化不仅使青少年的身体发育出成人特征，还使青少年难以在晚上11点前入睡。
青少年与睡眠相关的疾病。

ex.s: Why do teenagers go to sleep late according to Carskadon?
ex.t: 根据卡斯卡顿的说法，青少年为什么晚睡？

ex.s: The Princess Diaries Viewer reviews What an interesting movie 2 March | by Jane The princess Diaries is a movie about a teenager named Mia Thermopolis.
ex.t: 《公主日记》 观众评论 多有趣的电影 3月2日 | by Jane 《公主日记》是一部关于一个名叫 Mia Thermopolis 的少女的电影。

ex.s: As an ambulance driver, she’s seen a lot of car accidents involving teenagers and thinks the legal age for getting a driving licence should be 21.
ex.t: 作为救护车司机，她见过很多涉及青少年的车祸，认为拿驾照的法定年龄应为21岁。

ex.s: Instead of being the selfish teenager I used to be, I have begun to feel more aware of other people and to develop a stronger sense of social responsibility.
ex.t: 我不再做我曾经是自私的青少年，而是开始对其他人产生更多的了解，并培养出更强烈的社会责任感。

ex.s: For those who have no access to courses, help might be at hand thanks to Jerry Witkovsky and his method of using four jars to teach teenagers how to spend their money wisely.
ex.t: 对于那些无法参加课程的人，杰里·维特科夫斯基和他的方法或许能帮上忙——他用四个罐子教青少年如何明智地花钱。
